plugins.name: android-runner
plugins.description: Android device runner for ZCode: a side panel with devices, build, install, launch, logcat and scrcpy mirroring, plus zero-config detection of the Gradle project, adb, SDK, JDK and product flavors.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Android 设备运行器:ZCode 侧栏面板里看设备、编译、安装、启动、投屏、看日志;工程、SDK、JDK、adb、多渠道 flavor 全自动探测。
description_i18n.en: Android device runner for ZCode: a side panel with devices, build, install, launch, logcat and scrcpy mirroring, plus zero-config detection of the Gradle project, adb, SDK, JDK and product flavors.
